question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"series."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"series" **refers to a number of things or events that are arranged or happen one after the other. • It is a noun and can be used to describe a TV show or a set of books or movies. • **Example:*** **She gave a **series**__ of lectures last year.* • In this context, it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: When he was in college, a famous poet made a useful distinction for him. He had drunk __enough__ in the poet's company to be compelled to describe to him a poem he was __thinking__ of. It would be a monologue of sorts, the self-contemplation of a student on a summer afternoon who is reading Euphuise. The poem itself would be a subtle __**series**__ of euphuisms, translating the heat, the day, the student's concerns, into symmetrical posies; translating even his ______ (4) ______ and boredom with that famously foolish book into a euphuism. The poet nodded his big head in a sympathetic, rhythmic way as this was ______ (5) ______ to him, then told him that there are two kinds of poems. There is the kind you write; there is the kind you talk about in bars. Both kinds have value and both are poems; but it's fatal to confuse them. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Plains:** refers to a flat area of land with few trees. (कम वृक्षों वाला बड़ा समतल इलाक़ा; बड़ा सपाट मैदान) • **Credits:** refers to acknowledgement given to a person or organization for their contribution to something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में कुछ विशिष्‍ट गुण मानना; श्रेय देना, स्तुति करना) • **Races: **refers to a competition where people or animals compete to see who is the fastest. (दौड़-प्रतियोगिता (व्‍यक्तियों, पशुओं, कारों आदि की)) 4a:Tf14, The correct answer is **"contempt."**
